title: very comfortable. Love the Cooling gel foam
text: very comfortable. Love the Cooling gel foam. I love this mattress!  Upon opening it, there was no bad odor.  In fact, there was no odor at all!  That was pleasant considering some other mattresses I received smelled very must.  This one did not!  It's a comfortable mattress.  I can't say the cooling gel Memory foam keeps me really cool but I don't get as hot so that is a plus!

description: IMAGINE MATTRESS  Don't settle for an uncomfortable mattress that leaves you aching all over in the morning. Imagine Mattress offers the ideal cooling gel memory foam mattress to provide you with an effortless and restful night of sleep at an affordable price!   DUAL LAYER MATTRESS  Imagine Mattresses combine seamlessly combine support and comfort with an innovative two-layer design. A firm 8-inch foam core provides stability and support for unmatched lumbar support, while the 2-inch top layer provides soft, memory foam comfort that molds to your body. The 4-pound gel infused memory foam is extremely responsive for ultimate comfort.   GEL-INFUSED MEMORY FOAM  Stay cool and comfy all night long with gel-infused memory foam. Traditional memory foam mattresses can't compare to temperature regulating gel that keeps your body at a comfortable and consistent temp for uninterrupted and refreshing sleep.   MEDIUM FIRM FEEL  Shopping for the perfect mattress often leaves people feeling like Goldilocks. One bed is too hard, another bed is too soft. Where is that just-right mattress? Imagine conceptualized a bed that combines both extremes for something completely new! With a medium firm feel, you can lay down and feel immediate relief as the memory foam molds to the contours of your body allowing you to fall asleep with ease.   QUALITY CONSTRUCTION  Backed by a 25 year full-replacement warranty, all mattresses are proudly made in the USA and wrapped in ultra soft, sleek bamboo covers that are comfortable, breathable, and environment friendly with no harmful chemicals and only water-based adhesives.   - Imagine Cooling Gel Memory Foam Mattress  - Twin Size  - 10 Inch  - 25 Year Warranty
